title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES THE HIT MARKERS
why: The card was stamped v24.18 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. The card was stamped v24.18 and every ship stops when it falls 0.16 behind; about 20 queued builds are waiting. Its new line names the hit marker on the inner crosshair (his answer 30), the darker nights, SELL ALL and the counting RUN OVER score.
now: The what is new card names the hit markers and the darker nights.
